spell.madoka_magic.witch_black_wings.des: Sweep a fan of dark wings forward. Enemies caught in the slash receive butterfly marks.
spell.madoka_magic.witch_cocoon_burst.de: Detonate your butterfly marks on nearby enemies. More stacks cause more damage.
spell.madoka_magic.witch_venom.desc: Strike the enemy in your sights with a venomous needle that inflicts poison.
spell.madoka_magic.witch_honey_tide.desc: Release a wave of sticky honey, damaging and slowing nearby enemies.
spell.madoka_magic.witch_tear_rain.desc: Summon several waves of rain at the casting point. Each wave damages enemies still in the area.
spell.madoka_magic.witch_thorn_echo.desc: Pierce the nearby enemy that owes you the most guilt, consuming its debt.

message.madoka_magic.contract.already_co: You are already a magical girl.
message.madoka_magic.altar.no_recipe: These materials do not match a desk ritual.

jei.madoka_magic.altar.alternative: Hold an amethyst shard in each hand and use the main hand on a stripped log to turn it into a Wishing Desk.
jei.madoka_magic.grief_seed.source: Awarded to the player who deals the finishing blow to %s. Use to cleanse taint at the cost of durability.
screen.madoka_magic.contract.hint_devoti: If keeping this wish someday cost you what you cherish most, would you still make it?
screen.madoka_magic.contract.hint_selfis: Reach out. The power you want is right here. Are you willing to pay its price yourself?
screen.madoka_magic.spell_wheel.cast: Release the wheel key to cast
screen.madoka_magic.spell_wheel.cancel: Move to select. Release in the center to cancel.
screen.madoka_magic.info.title: Magical Girl Profile
screen.madoka_magic.witch_portal_test: Barrier Entrance Test · Pick a Witch
screen.madoka_magic.witch_choice.title: You became a witch
screen.madoka_magic.witch_choice.desc: Keep your magical girl identity, or give it up?
message.madoka_magic.witch_power_inherit: You inherited your witch's power. Use the transformation key to reveal your witch form.
spell.madoka_magic.butterfly_slash.desc: Sweep a cone in front of you. Hitting at least one target restores 1 health. A missed swing still spends mana.
spell.madoka_magic.tulip_burst.desc: Burst tulips around you, damaging nearby enemies and leaving butterfly marks.
spell.madoka_magic.bee_sting.desc: Sting the enemy you aim at and poison it for 5 seconds.
spell.madoka_magic.swarm_call.desc: Summon bees that follow you for a short time. They pursue nearby familiars and sting using your magic stats.
spell.madoka_magic.dandelion_drift.desc: Release seeds that seek honey-coated enemies first and spread honey on impact.
spell.madoka_magic.honey.desc: Coat the ground you aim at with honey, slowing familiars that enter. Level aim places it on the ground ahead.
spell.madoka_magic.injection.desc: Sting a familiar to restore health and mana. Honey-coated targets yield more health.
spell.madoka_magic.illusion.desc: Make nearby familiars temporarily attack allies they can see.
spell.madoka_magic.devotion_wing.desc: Each damaging attack or spell adds one butterfly mark. One golden butterfly orbits the target per mark, up to five.
spell.madoka_magic.selfish_eye.desc: Hits steal attack damage, health, and mana. Excess healing grants absorption. Keep a share of the stolen stats permanently when combat ends.
spell.madoka_magic.obsession.desc: Each kill adds a stack: +8% damage per stack, up to 5. Cleared after 20s without a kill.
spell.madoka_magic.ember.desc: Every 10 points of taint grants +2% damage. Burn yourself for power.
spell.madoka_magic.sin_mark.desc: Whenever an enemy damages you, it is branded and owes you guilt (capped at 50% of its max health). Guilt fuels Redemption Blade and the Unpayable Promise.
spell.madoka_magic.thorn_embrace.desc: Grow deep-blue thorns around you, binding up to 8 enemies for 6 seconds. This interrupts witch windups. Bound targets cannot start new Madoka skills, take damage each second, and accumulate guilt. Attacking them causes backlash.
spell.madoka_magic.redemption_blade.desc: Lock onto the enemy that owes you the most guilt, spend it for a burst of damage (execution: ignores same-faction reduction). You suffer 20% of the spent guilt as backlash.
spell.madoka_magic.unpayable_promise.des: Make a 10-second pact with a familiar that owes you guilt. Take 30% of its damage and return the stored remainder when the pact ends. The pool is lost if the target dies or leaves tether range.
spell.madoka_magic.pollen.desc: Damage over time to all enemies with butterfly marks; each stack grants +12% damage. Unmarked enemies are immune.
spell.madoka_magic.blossom.desc: Enter Bloom: costs 6 mana per second and your damage grows the longer the fight lasts. Running out of mana triggers the Fall.
spell.madoka_magic.wither.desc: Spend 15% of your health for a burst of damage. Hold Shift to pay with 10 taint instead. +50% damage while fallen.
message.madoka_magic.barrier_need_taint: You need at least %s taint to enter half-witch form.
message.madoka_magic.witchification_warn: Taint has swallowed your Soul Gem. Witchification is imminent.
message.madoka_magic.weapon.counter_read: Guarded. Your next strike can counter.
message.madoka_magic.weapon.skill_locked: This weapon art is still locked.
message.madoka_magic.arena.charmed: Charm slows your steps and restores the Witch of Taking's health.
screen.madoka_magic.contract.hint_presse: The past won't disappear. Are you willing to carry it with you and make a new wish?
